hook.name: SentryInkXStockFeeHook
hook.description: A launch-pool hook for Ink CAMPAIGN/wXSTOCK pairs that applies a time-decaying dynamic fee (high flat rate decaying via half-life to a floor) and skims 25% of each swap's fee in the wrapper token as holder reflections, routing the skim to treasury during a configurable post-launch delay. Swaps are gated to an owner-set router and quoter address.
